statement: The working transport model for the original Elite Series 1 is wired USB or proprietary Xbox Wireless receiver, not Bluetooth HID. This is a planning inference from the source family split and the external product-generation distinction; the pinned xpad and SDL code by themselves cannot prove absence of Bluetooth radio hardware, and no original-model wireless reference was tested.

applicability.revision: original Xbox Elite Series 1 versus Elite Series 2
applicability.scope: Do not promote to device-protocol evidence or add a Bluetooth realization without pinned original-model manufacturer evidence and physical verification. Receiver behavior is owned by separate Xbox Wireless transport work.
